extraction.Name: Theresa Big Crow, nee Garcia
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee to her allotment, covering lots 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 & 9, & SEI of NWA & of SWa, Sec. 3, Lot 6, Sec. 4, NW2, Sec. 10, T 40N. R.44W; that she was advised that she would be forced to take it at any rate for the 480 acres, so she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: about 1923, she sold her allotment to Roman Koskey, of Chadron, Nebraska, for $2000.00 cash and a note for $3000.00; that, in one year's time, Mr. Koskey died, and the land reverted to herself; that she knew that she could not pay the taxes, so she sold the note to bankers at Oelrichs, South Dakota, he paying her partly in cattle and horses and cash for this $3000.00 note, and the land passed into his possession
extraction.Buyer: Roman Koskey, of Chadron, Nebraska, for $2000.00 cash and a note for $3000.00; land subsequently passed to bankers at Oelrichs, South Dakota
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she knew that she could not pay the taxes, so she sold the note to bankers at Oelrichs, South Dakota
extraction.Occupation/Income: she personally realizes $64.00 per year off of rental of a half of section of land, owned by a former husband, that this land is used for an airport; husband works at common labor whenever he can get it
extraction.NOTES: Deponent has never received any aid from the County or Government; husband supports her and nine minor children, whose health is good; husband's health is good; it is pretty close living on their income; allotment covers 480 acres; document sworn November 17, 1928; No. 2765
